_semantics.frameAdvance: Animator2D.Update: time+=dt; if time >= interval*currentFrame: sprite=frames[currentFrame]; currentFrame++ ; then fire events whose frame == new currentFrame
_semantics.finish: IsAnimationFinished: time >= interval*length. loop -> Play(name, restart=true) else isPlaying=false
_semantics.play: Play(name, restart): only resets if name differs from current OR restart==true
